checks.name: 574 unique nodes, 27 transformations, five pacts
Every node connected to origin; all costs integral
Every legal route is connected and has the displayed cost
Unreachable, unknown, malformed and overspent plans are rejected atomically
Mutually exclusive transformations and maximum two pacts
Deleting a node preserves an alternate connected route
Deleting a sole entry refunds the entire isolated branch exactly
Laboratory maximization cannot grant campaign points
Legacy refund preserves all 4890 earned points without doubling
R66 load / save / reload and exported record preserve campaign and graph
Corrupt save prunes disconnected nodes without generating points
Knowledge boss can award only once per world and stage
Gold passives are applied exactly once and per source
Village production ignores every passive and artifact bonus
Shared cost helper respects mana, cooldown and duration bounds
Arsenal retains campaign support passives and the 80% cap
All nine skills reject unequipped, locked and insufficient-mana casts
Every accepted cast pays the shared cost exactly; no visual on rejection
One loot/XP reward per victim, finite curse reactions at 320 enemies
Clear/load clears delayed waves and zones
Zone and delayed-event limits are enforced
Lab snapshot restores earned points and build

Fury momentum refunds at most one cooldown second per simulation second
Fury bloodroad damages enemies along the path and at the distant pack
